content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Explain that chemical reactions involve energy changes
Distinguish between exothermic and endothermic reactions
Give examples of each type of reaction
. Energy is either released to the surroundings or absorbed from them. Understanding these energy changes is important in industry, everyday life, and understanding how reactions occur.
